**Finding: INSURANCE — compliant (no redline).**

Section 18 of the agreement already sits at our **preferred** position:

- **CGL:** USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate (18.1)
- **Professional E&O:** USD 2,000,000 (18.1)
- **Cyber/privacy:** USD 5,000,000 — granted unconditionally, which exceeds the conditional preferred element given Vendor processes Customer Data under § 17
- **Workers' compensation:** as required by law (18.1)
- **Certificates:** available on request (18.2)

Clause 18.2 also adds favourable terms beyond the checklist (reputable insurers, primary coverage where customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities), and 18.1 carries the coverage for one year after the term at Vendor's own expense. Nothing here benefits Vendor at our expense, so no redline was proposed.
